doc: The same tower inside Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration / Qwen3_5MoeForConditionalGeneration: its configuration is the wrapper's `vision_config` and its tensors live under `model.visual.` (`visual.` aliased at binding). The wrapper itself is read as its text decoder (vlm-qwen3-5); this adapter is reached by `match.tower_of`. Features: VISION_FROM_SPEC_V1.
